correctness.rationale: On M_k={0,a_1,...,a_k,1}, k>=2, axioms (1)–(5) force identity top row 1⇒x=x, constant zero row t, and each atom row determined by u_i=a_i⇒0 and v_i=a_i⇒a_i. The monotonicity/meet identities and axiom (5) reduce allowed pairs to (0,a_i),(a_i,a_i),(0,1),(1,1),(a_j,1) for j≠i: k+3 local types. For t=0, only u_i=0 and two v_i options per atom; for t=a_s the distinguished row has two choices and every other row three; for t=1 all k+3 row types independent. These are sufficient for all quantified axiom-5 instances because a_i∧y∈{0,a_i}. Summation gives N_k=2^k+2k*3^(k−1)+(k+3)^k. The known induced form ν(x)∨(x∧y) is injective and antitonic ν(1)=0, with t=ν(0) and choices ν(a_i)≤t giving I_k=1+k*2^k+(k+2)^k; ratio tends e^-1. Independently reconstructed exhaustive five-axiom tables k=2,3: 41/25 and 278/150, including t-strata. No finite check substitutes for the all-k proof.

value.rationale: The finite rank-two bounded lattices form a natural test family whose k>=3 members are nondistributive. A complete labeled normal form and exact induced-subclass proportion identify the size of the K-preconditional class and demonstrate asymptotic nonrepresentability by unary precomplementations. This is independently useful semantics data, not a mere renaming of the k=2 Boolean case.
